test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two boys start from the same place walking at the speeds of 5.5 km/h and 3.5 km/h, respectively, in the same direction. What time will they take to be 8.8 km apart?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the two boys are 5.5 km/h and 3.5 km/h

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/speed

Relative Speed of 2 bodies:

The relative speed of two objects = Difference in their individual speeds if they are moving in the same direction.

**Calculation:**

The relative speed of the two boys = 5.5 - 3.5
